phase: V2.1 - Provider-Neutral Image Edit Protocol & Three-Model Bake-Off Preparation
purpose: The exact 3 real local source images the (not-yet-executed) 3x3=9-run provider bake-off matrix will use. Selected once, reused identically across all 3 candidate models so the comparison is fair - never a different image per model.
selection_rule: No human portrait in this first bake-off (explicit instruction). Case 1 = hero product/iPhone for hardware fidelity. Case 2 = a second physical gadget, distinct from Case 1, for geometry/detail preservation. Case 3 = a bright/saturated promotional image.

cases.source: Reused unchanged from assets/brand/newsroom_visuals/v2_recomposition_local_proof/hero_product_iphone__1_raw_source.jpg (Phase V2 design-only local-proof selection) - a clean iPhone product shot on a solid orange background, zero collision risk, pulled read-only via docker cp from the ai_newsroom_telegram_bot container's shared image_storage_data volume, no network, no DB writes.
cases.rationale: Hardware-fidelity test: a clean, unambiguous single-product hero shot with sharp geometric edges (device silhouette, screen bezel) - the model must preserve exact hardware design per the FORBIDDEN clause in the canonical prompt ("change hardware design").

cases.source: Selected fresh from the existing local photo pool at scratchpad/real_photo_candidates/ (same read-only docker cp pull, no network, no DB writes) - filename is its own content hash (83761c78...).
cases.rationale: Geometry/detail-preservation test: a close macro angle showing a phone screen edge/bezel against a physical keyboard - two distinct hardware objects with fine repeating geometric detail (individual keyboard keys, screen corner radius) that a lossy recomposition would visibly distort or smooth over. Distinct device/brand from Case 1 (a different phone + a keyboard, not another isolated iPhone shot) so the bake-off is not testing the exact same object twice.

cases.source: Reused unchanged from assets/brand/newsroom_visuals/v2_recomposition_local_proof/bright_promotional_scene__1_raw_source.jpg (Phase V2 design-only local-proof selection).
cases.rationale: Bright/saturated-background stress test: high-chroma promotional colors are the exact condition the V1 graphite-overlay bake-off found hardest to keep legible/faithful against - reused here as the third, deliberately different lighting/color regime.

excluded_by_rule.portrait_public_figure__1_raw_source.jpg: Excluded - contains a human portrait, explicitly forbidden for this first bake-off.

no_network_no_paid_calls: This file only records local selection of already-local image bytes. No image-generation provider was called to produce this file.
